title: 第17章 价值十亿的帝王金玉第18章 请问是唐先生吗
lines: 七块原石。
开出五个品质绝佳的高级翡翠，再加上一个极品血翡。
要不是亲眼所见，根本没人敢相信。
可现在。
众人呆呆的看向唐明，在他面前那排列整齐的翡翠，发出熠熠光芒，夺人心魄。
唐明扭头询问：“老先生，这些能值多少钱？”
袁正河眸光闪烁，微微思忖后答道：“极品血翡很稀有，有市无价，你这块血翡刚出世，内部血丝保存完整，若是放在拍卖会场竞价的话……两千六百万不成问题。”
“其余的高级翡翠，市场价在八十万一块，五块价值总共四百万。”
话音刚落。
人群中心响起倒吸凉气的声音。
这少年空手而来，依靠两百元翻本，竟然赚到了三千万！
那可是三千万啊，是多少普通人望而却步的数字，可对那个少年来说，不过挑选了几块石头而已。
“三千万，应该可以帮柳姨解决财务危机了。”
唐明微微一笑，随后目光中噙着期待，看向最后那颗硕大的原石。
这，才是他的终极目标。
“真正的绝世隗宝，却被人遗忘，这聚宝阁也不像想象中那么专业。”
“不过我倒是要感谢聚宝阁。”
“将其遗忘这么久，反倒成全了我。”
唐明眼眸精芒，死死盯着那块足有篮球大小的原石。
一记手刀劈砍下来。
原石应声裂开，没有爆出丝毫绿芒，甚至连寻常玉石正常的光芒都没有迹象。
“爷爷，这块原石里面有料吗？”袁雨萱紧张兮兮道。
“以我多年的经验看，这块原石石料普通粗糙，不可能孕育出温润的翡翠……咦！”
袁正河正准备摇头的时候，突然惊疑出声。
因为唐明，又切出一刀，左边那半块原石再次分裂
袁正河的眼眸，正死死盯着其中一块原石碎片，拳头大小的碎石上，泛出惊艳的紫金色。
“金芒透壁而出，如夕阳残辉，又如紫日东升，这莫非是……”
老人家呢喃出声，浑身开始颤栗起来。
而这时候，唐明却没有采取先前那种粗暴的手段，反而是拎起纤细锋利的切石刀，绕着石壁周围轻轻一刮。
这一刀下去，原石内骤然爆出金芒！
紧接着第二刀，第三刀……
“我的天！”
“一刀金芒现，二刀出紫霄，三刀色泽合，这……这是帝王金玉！”
袁正河惊呼出声，情绪异常的激动。
帝王金玉？
这个叫声，把所有人都给吓了一跳。
不仅如此，店铺内院，其他鉴宝老师傅全部涌了出来，满脸激动的看向面前那块宝玉。
看台上。
一颗拳头大小的宝玉静立在原地，通体泛出鲜艳金黄色，其中又蕴含着紫色光芒，熠熠生辉，美得令人心神动荡。
“翡似金阳，翠如青紫，紫金融合方为帝玉，这的确是帝王金玉！”
“古籍记载‘紫皮金心，帝王至尊’，开出帝王金玉，不亚于气运暴涨！”
“据说开出帝王金玉者，鸿运滔天。”
“帝王金玉多少年没出现了，我上一次听闻，还是从我祖爷爷那里听说的。”
content_en:
Seven rough stones.
Five high-grade jadeite of excellent quality were opened, plus a top-grade blood jadeite.
If they hadn't seen it with their own eyes, no one would have believed it.
But now.
Everyone stared blankly at Tang Ming. The neatly arranged emeralds in front of him shone with a dazzling light, which was breathtaking.
Tang Ming turned around and asked, "Old sir, how much are these worth?"
Yuan Zhenghe's eyes flickered, and he thought for a moment before replying: "The best blood jade is very rare, and it is priceless in the market. This blood jade of yours has just been born, and the blood streaks inside are intact. If you put it in the auction venue for bidding... 26 million will not be a problem."
"The remaining high-grade jadeite has a market price of 800,000 yuan per piece, and five pieces are worth a total of 4 million."
The words just fell.
"Hiss——"
There was a gasp from the center of the crowd.
This young man came here empty-handed, relied on two hundred yuan to make a profit, and actually made thirty million!
That was 30 million, a number that was prohibitive for many ordinary people, but for that boy, it was just a few stones.
"Thirty million should be enough to help Aunt Liu solve her financial crisis."
Tang Ming smiled slightly, then looked at the last huge rough stone with expectation in his eyes.
This is his ultimate goal.
"The real peerless treasure has been forgotten by others, and this treasure gathering pavilion is not as professional as imagined."
"But I would like to thank the Jubao Pavilion."
"Forgetting it for so long actually served me well."
Tang Ming's eyes were shining, staring at the rough stone that was the size of a basketball.
Cut it down with a hand knife.
"Click——"
The original stone cracked open without any green light, not even the normal light of ordinary jade.
"Grandpa, is there any material in this rough stone?" Yuan Yuxuan asked nervously.
"Based on my many years of experience, this rough stone is generally rough and it is impossible to produce warm jadeite... Eh!"
Just when Yuan Zhenghe was about to shake his head, he suddenly made a sound of surprise.
Because Tang Ming made another cut, the half of the original stone on the left split again.
Yuan Zhenghe's eyes were staring at one of the original stone fragments. The fist-sized gravel was glowing with a stunning purple-gold color.
"The golden light shines through the wall, like the afterglow of the setting sun, or like the purple sun rising in the east. Could this be..."
The old man murmured and his whole body began to tremble.
But at this time, Tang Ming did not use the rough method as before. Instead, he picked up a slender and sharp stone cutting knife and gently scraped around the stone wall.
With this sword strike, golden light suddenly burst out from the original stone!
Then the second knife, the third knife...
"Oh my God!"
"One sword appears with golden light, two swords emerge from the purple sky, and three swords merge in color. This... this is imperial gold and jade!"
Yuan Zhenghe exclaimed, feeling extremely excited.
Imperial gold and jade?
This cry startled everyone.
Not only that, in the inner courtyard of the shop, other master treasure appraisers all came out, looking at the jade in front of them with excitement.
In the stands.
A fist-sized jade stood quietly on the spot, its whole body glowing with a bright golden color, and it also contained purple light, shining so brightly that it was so beautiful that it made people's hearts tremble.
"Emerald is like the golden sun, emerald is like green purple, and when purple is combined, it becomes imperial jade. This is indeed imperial gold and jade!"
"It is recorded in ancient books that 'Purple-skinned golden heart, the emperor is supreme'. If you get imperial gold and jade, it is no less than a surge in luck!"
"It is said that those who get imperial gold and jade will have great luck."
"Imperial gold and jade haven't appeared in many years. The last time I heard about it, I heard about it from my grandfather."
title_en: Chapter 17 Imperial Gold and Jade Worth One Billion Chapter 18 Is this Mr. Tang?
